name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Security hardening: stalled or failed stream relays no longer write credential-bearing playback or Plex URLs to Jellyfin logs; diagnostics retain only the upstream host. Friend/Plex server base addresses containing embedded credentials, query parameters, or fragments are rejected before they can be persisted, logged, or produce broken API endpoints. Includes regression coverage for both protections.
